resources.string: The web address of your family\'s Daylight home service. You can change it later: touch and hold the app icon, then choose Change home address.
Use an https:// address with no path, for example https://home.example.org
The address of the laptop that runs the relay, its access key, and the room to show. Touch and hold Live 3D to change them later.
Access key (one is saved: leave empty to keep it)
Check the address (https://, or a local http:// address in a test build), the access key and the room name.
